basic_details.job_title: CARI Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central Ayurveda Research Institute (CARI), Patiala will hold a walk-in written test and interview on 30 November 2026 at Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Moti Bagh Road, Patiala. Registration runs from 09:00 AM to 10.00 AM, and the written test starts at 11:00 AM. The walk-in is for 2 posts of Consultant (Ayurveda) on a contractual basis under Advertisement No. 04/2026-27, with a pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month consolidated.

content_sections.heading: CARI Patiala Consultant (Ayurveda) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: 09:00 AM to 10.00 AM (registration will not be allowed after 10:00 AM)
Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Moti Bagh Road, Patiala
Post Graduates in Ayurveda, or Graduates in Ayurveda with 02 years of additional experience, aged up to 45 years

content_sections.heading: About CARI Patiala
content_sections.text: Central Ayurveda Research Institute (CARI) is located on Moti Bagh Road in Patiala. The institute is holding this walk-in to engage Consultants (Ayurveda) on contract. The notice is signed by the Director (Institute), and it names www.ccras.nic.in as the Council's website for the bio-data format.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: CARI Patiala will engage 2 Consultants (Ayurveda) on a purely contractual basis. The engagement is initially for 06 months. The competent authority may extend or curtail it on need basis, subject to the performance of the individual. The remuneration is Rs. 60,000/- per month, consolidated. The notice also says that the number of posts may be increased or decreased at the discretion of the competent authority. Post Graduation in Ayurveda OR Graduation in Ayurveda (with additional experience of 02 years) The experience column of the post table reads "05-10 years". M.S. (Shalya) for one post Knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint The age limit is upto 45 years as on the date of the interview. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application format asks for the following details: A latest passport size photograph must be pasted on the form, and the candidate must sign the declaration.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration runs from 09:00 AM to 10.00 AM on 30 November 2026. Registration will not be allowed after 10:00 AM. Candidates submit the application in the prescribed format, two passport size photographs and self-attested photocopies of their certificates. Original certificates are verified. The written test is held at 11:00 AM. The interview follows the written test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis, and no claim for regular appointment will be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test or interview. The declaration on the form states that a candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated without notice or compensation if any information is found false or incorrect at any stage.

rows.details: Prescribed format to bring to the walk-in

faq.question: Q1. When is the CARI Patiala Consultant (Ayurveda) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in written test and interview will be held on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Registration runs from 09:00 AM to 10.00 AM and will not be allowed after 10:00 AM. The written test starts at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Moti Bagh Road, Patiala.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Consultant (Ayurveda). The number of posts may be increased or decreased at the discretion of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduation in Ayurveda, or a Graduation in Ayurveda with 02 years of additional experience. The experience column of the post table lists 05-10 years, and M.S. (Shalya) is desirable for one post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is upto 45 years as on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a CARI Patiala Consultant (Ayurveda)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 60,000/- per month, consolidated.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the application in the prescribed format, original certificates, the experience certificate, a set of self-attested photocopies and two recent passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test at 11:00 AM on 30 November 2026, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Consultant (Ayurveda) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, initially for six months, and no claim for regular appointment will be entertained. No TA/DA is paid for attending.
